parse.title: Headache
parse.wikitext:
<onlyinclude>
A '''headache''' can be described as a pain anywhere in the region of the head or neck. It can be a symptom of a number of different conditions. This occurs in migraines (sharp, or throbbing pains), tension-type headaches, and cluster headaches.<ref>{{Citation | title=Headache disorders - WHO | url=https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/headache-disorders | access-date=4 June 2022}}</ref>

It is worth noting that due to its lacks of pain receptors, headaches are not caused by pain within the brain tissue itself, instead, headaches are caused by disturbances of the pain-sensitive structures around the brain.

Headaches are most commonly induced under the influence of [[dosage#heavy|heavy]] [[dosage|dosages]] of [[stimulation|stimulating]] compounds, such as traditional [[stimulant|stimulants]], certain [[psychedelic|psychedelics]], and certain [[dissociative|dissociatives]]. This holds particularly true during the offset of the experience and if the person is [[Dehydration|dehydrated]] or has not eaten enough food.</onlyinclude>
